correctness.rationale: The exact h-fold sumset is -hb+2bs+(3b+1)t with s,t>=0,s+t<=h. At h=6b-3 with even b>=2, gcd(2b,3b+1)=1, residues are covered by s=0,...,3b and source proof checks starting and ending arithmetic-progression endpoints at T=9b²-3. Independently enumerated all multiplicity choices for b=2,4,6,8 and verified entire [0,T] is covered but T+1 absent from this basis. For the universal odd-h upper N=(h²+6h+1)/4, the residue class ha-x mod y forces s>=y-1 at first and last representatives and gives 0<=-(y-(h+3)/2)^2, forcing y=(h+3)/2 and h|(x-1) with 1<=x-1<h, impossible. Thus C passes; however upper bound itself is previously published, and independent finite tests cannot replace infinite residue argument.
